_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Fourthwall's five public hosts each declare their own layer (raw/css-vars.json): the Webflow marketing --_primitives---/--_surface---/--_rhythm---/ramp vocabulary in light (+ the on-ink dark-section resolutions in ink), the catalogue's --color-/--bg-/--text-/... names in catalog (light-dark() light branch), catalogDark (the dark branch under a forced color-scheme — declared, not painted) and signup (the same DS resolved light on /get-started), the Mintlify --gray-/--primary vocabulary in docs/docsDark (the real theme menu) and the Docusaurus --ifm-/--fw- layer in help/helpDark (the real toggle). Measured roles alias to the declared values they match.
